description:
Found in the 2026-10-13 focus review. Three roadmaps exist (docs/project.md Roadmap, docs/scope.md 'Not yet' ticket ids, beadwork) and the first two are stale: project.md ticks none of the five epics opened 9-13 Oct and lists defk-gqk and defk-6ag as open (both closed); its 'Where things are' table points at lib/examples.ex, which lives at test/support/examples.ex. Root clutter: demo.exs beside mix.exs instead of with bench/, scripts/ mixes the byte-identical gate (dump_c.exs, a dev tool) with the fuzz and Valgrind verification tooling for defk-96f.

Do:
- docs/project.md: fix the table; replace the Roadmap section with the list of beadwork epics and a pointer (bw prime, bw show <epic>), no per-ticket checklist.
- docs/scope.md 'Not yet' / 'Under exploration': reference epics, not task ids, where a task id would go stale.
- Move demo.exs to bench/demo.exs and scripts/dump_c.exs to dev/dump_c.exs; rename scripts/ to verify/ (fuzz/, valgrind/); update every reference (mix.exs aliases, docs, READMEs, scripts' own relative paths).
- Delete erl_crash.dump and the contents of tmp/ (both git-ignored); delete the branches prototype/compile-errors and prototype/defk-dtw.18-sketches (their decisions are recorded in defk-dtw.8 and defk-dtw.18).

Done when: mix ci is green, no document in the repo references a moved path, and docs/project.md names beadwork as the only roadmap.

comments.text: docs/scope.md left as is: every ticket id in 'Not yet' and 'Under exploration' is a live ticket chosen per construct (defk-nii, defk-pe3, defk-n4r.3, defk-oit, defk-ulk, defk-7dm, defk-sgw.5, defk-djy.8, defk-sve), and test/scope_doc_test.exs requires one ticket per bullet, so there is no stale id to replace with an epic. Done in the main checkout: erl_crash.dump and tmp/ contents deleted, the two prototype branches deleted.

title: Housekeeping: one roadmap in beadwork, root cleanup, stale paths
